rationale: Regional right lateral ventricular omission repair: all registered300 X350-451 planes (102) and six representative Y/Z contact sheets (18 planes) visually inspected. Candidates supplement the lumen rim and its terminal recess as the cavity narrows laterally; internal frond-like gray tissue remains unfilled. The outer cavity is separated from cortical sulci by tissue in the reviewed planes. At least 50 percent finite-cell overlap is a locator rule, not anatomical proof. Existing nonzero labels including 8, 18 and 22 are preserved.
limitation: AI image review, not expert review or ground truth. Representative Y/Z checks are not exhaustive; no new native100 review. Crop continuation and other ventricular omissions remain unresolved. Integration verification recorded separately; not public deployment.
